OWNER PREVIEW · NOVEMBER 5, 2026

A few clear details.

This is the working preview of CleanQuote by AmericanSites. Purchases are not currently enabled. The proposed offer is $29 USD for a one-time download; final seller contact details and commercial policies must be set before checkout opens.

Your quote records

The app stores your business profile, current draft, logo, and saved quotes in your browser’s local storage on your device. The app does not upload those records to a cloud account or sync them across devices. Other people using the same browser profile may be able to access them. Export backups regularly, store them privately, and avoid putting sensitive customer information into a shared device.

Website and payments

The website host may process normal technical request data. No advertising pixel or analytics tracker has been added to this preview. The prepared checkout integration uses Stripe’s hosted payment page; card information is handled by Stripe. Once enabled, order records would be stored by the seller for fulfillment and support. That payment service has not been activated or verified for this product.

What the toolkit does

CleanQuote prepares cost-based estimates, customer documents, and text you can copy. You provide and verify the scope, costs, rates, fees, and taxes. Calculations are estimates, and results do not guarantee income or job profitability. The customer estimate does not show internal labor pay, costs, or profit.

Download and device use

The downloadable app is intended for modern desktop browsers. Its records stay in the browser used to open it. Opening local HTML files, copying text, and saving PDFs vary on mobile devices. Future major versions, hosted storage, automated messages, scheduling, and lifetime support are not included in the proposed offer.

Commercial policy still pending

The owner launch pack contains a draft one-business license and a proposed 14-day refund policy. These drafts are not an active sales offer. A verified seller support email, final policy, tax setup, delivery recovery method, and a tested checkout are required before accepting orders.
